hints.title: Flattened Index Mapping Obstacle
hints.text: Reshaping an m x n matrix into an r x c matrix row by row requires verifying that total cell count is preserved. How can a single index variable map from 1D offset directly into both 2D geometries?

hints.title: Linear Coordinate Divmod Invariant
hints.text: A 1D index k maps to original row k // n and col k % n, and maps to target row k // c and col k % c without allocating intermediate flattened arrays.

hints.title: Single Loop Coordinate Mapping Procedure
hints.text: Verify m * n == r * c; if not, return original mat. Allocate an r x c matrix. Loop index k from 0 to m * n - 1: assign res[k // c][k % c] = mat[k // n][k % n]. Return res.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every cell is transferred in a single pass in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Flattening into a separate 1D array doubles space consumption.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical divmod coordinate mapping eliminates auxiliary arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Checking m * n == r * c precondition before matrix allocation.
